content: Gotiꞌa kini vekamo lekana paino ateꞌniya yokemae
Na kavaꞌmo hisayafeꞌmo malaga vayaꞌmogi apavamusa valeteꞌa apano neꞌae. Vayaꞌmogimo, mani kavaꞌmo hugune, huꞌa apakesamo neꞌafiyaꞌmonanafa afaꞌa osugae.

Ma mopafi kava vayaꞌe kini vayaꞌapimogiꞌeꞌmo Ala kava netegaꞌe lekana paino ateteno uvelimo lakino faleno ateꞌniya vekalegaꞌeꞌmo kame huꞌana anatesayafeꞌmo aliꞌa anupa huꞌa maiꞌneꞌa vegemo huꞌapaeꞌmo, yagaiꞌana latesaꞌagetaeꞌmo anaiyafiꞌmo oꞌmaigune, huꞌa nehae.
Kokuꞌnapiꞌmo fai maiꞌniya vekamoꞌa kigi huno apategaiye. Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa, afa gemo nehae, huno nehiye.
Aipamo leno apateꞌnenoꞌaeꞌmo lokiya gefatiꞌmo nehigeꞌapaeꞌmo atete nehae.
Agaemo, ani kavaꞌmo nehayaꞌmonanafa nagaemo Saiyoni kotega naote aveleꞌmo lekana paiꞌna ateꞌnova kini vekamoꞌa yagaino apatesiyafeꞌmo lekana paiꞌna ateꞌnove, huno hapa paiꞌniye.
Kini vekamoꞌa, Ala kava neꞌmoꞌa hu maleꞌniya gemo aeꞌna hakalo huꞌna lapa paiguve, huno huꞌniye. Agaemo, Hemeni afinaꞌmo mafaꞌneꞌnimo aliꞌna kateꞌnogeka maiꞌnane, huno naha paiꞌniye.
Ge huka nafi gegeꞌnao muki alu nofi vaya alu nofi vayaꞌmo apavaleꞌna aliꞌna kayapiꞌmo apatesugeno muki ma mopamo kagaika yaꞌmo haneno.
Kalipa mopaletiꞌmo alo nehaya samomo kayotetiꞌmo amagiꞌnageno aino atagino aise aise nehiya kava huka aeni kayotetiꞌmo apamagigane, huno naha paiꞌniye.
Ani ge huꞌniyaꞌmofeꞌmo kini vayaꞌmogitapae, huꞌna, alagepa hutapa afiyo. Ma mopafiꞌmo neꞌyagaiya vayane, huꞌna, ehetapiye.
Lapakaemo koli nehutapaekeꞌmo Ala kava neꞌmo aliꞌyaꞌamo aliyo. Atete nehutapaekeꞌmo lapamogaga aiyo.

Mafaꞌneꞌamo haetapa neyo. Fiku yanageno aipamo aiseꞌamo leno lapateteno lapamagisigetapa kateꞌmo asagautapa aigayanagi. Agaepiꞌmo eꞌa fala kiꞌa neꞌmaiya vayaꞌmogimo Goti aulagaleꞌmo alagepa huꞌa maiꞌnayanageꞌa afaꞌa apamogaga aigae.
